name: camayoc_falsifiers_not_rerun
description: verification-and-liveness Q3: 'X is fixed/landed/deployed' claims whose falsifier was last run BEFORE a given change — stale proofs wearing current ones' clothes. The comparison is read-time: verifiedAt is a fact of the run, and 'still current' is never stored.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label ?claim ?verifiedAt WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:verifies ?claim ; aegis:verifiedAt ?verifiedAt . FILTER(?verifiedAt < "{changedAt}") } ORDER BY ?verifiedAt
